decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart (wrapped: Data Centre, Medical Sciences, Sports Centre): vertical bars
5 values against 8 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: 3,412 MWh, 2,236 MWh, 1,905 MWh, 1,577 MWh, 1,284 MWh (G6.16, G7.4)
wrapped onto two lines: Data Centre, Medical Sciences, Sports Centre
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “electricity used in 2025”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
Board's ceiling (3,000,000) as a dotted line in the dark grey across the plot, labelled at its end in bold (D-21 (c), G8.13, G7.16)

findings.message: the Board's ceiling (ceiling) lies at 3,000,000, an order of magnitude or more outside the data (1,284 to 3,412): it is most likely given in another unit than the data's; give its unit (and factor) so that it is converted, or correct it
